verdict.rationale: Qodo has no documented REST/HTTP public API: every OpenAPI/Swagger probe path returned 404. Its documented programmatic surfaces are an official MCP server for connecting Qodo skills to "a remote or custom agent, workflow, or application" (retrieve/resolve findings, retrieve rules) and a CLI, plus config-as-code via .pr_agent.toml. That gives agents a narrow driving interface, not a general public API. Missing for 10: a documented public REST/GraphQL API with an endpoint reference/OpenAPI spec, programmatic control of the full platform (triggering reviews, managing repos/settings), and auth/rate-limit documentation.
